title: change-reviewer agent findings
description: What the change-reviewer agent hands back to `gate.js finalize`. The agent judges; it never decides the exit code. Anything that fails this schema is rejected and the gate is inconclusive.

positives.description: What is good in the diff. Rendered when non-empty.

declaredLimitations.description: Limitations the diff declares (data the model does not support, deferred behaviour). The honesty rule blocks inference that is NOT declared here and in the PR.

contextObservations.description: Conventions the agent extracted from CLAUDE.md prose and applied as judgement context. Informational; never changes the rule set.
